description: This file implements the App class for a Windows application, handling application lifecycle events such as launch, suspension, and navigation failure. It also initializes the UI and sets localization preferences.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class handling startup, suspension, and navigation failure events.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Constructor initializing the application and subscribing to suspension events.

methods.name: OnLaunched
methods.description: Handles application launch, sets up the main window, initializes UI, and runs tests.

methods.name: OnSuspending
methods.description: Handles application suspension, intended to save state.

methods.name: OnNavigationFailed
methods.description: Handles navigation failures by throwing an exception.
